Information from the internet, personal communications and private files are all accessible to you. But, be warned, the information you supply will have consequences.

tc.name: Orwell: Keeping an Eye On You
tc.short_description: 老大哥来了——那个人就是你。调查市民的生活，找出恐怖袭击的凶手。来自网络，社交，私人文件的信息全部都可为你敞开。但是请注意，你提供的这些信息也许会有后果……

en.name: Travellers Rest
en.short_description: Craft, farm, build and cook! In Travellers Rest you will have to use all the available tools to become the best tavern keeper in the realm. Create unique dishes and drinks to please your customers as you discover the world and its colorful characters.

tc.name: 旅者之憩 Travellers Rest
tc.short_description: 制作，种田，建造和烹饪！在《旅者之憩》中，你可以使用各种工具成为这个国度中最棒的酒馆老板。制作独特的菜肴和饮料服务顾客，探索世界，遇见特色鲜明的各个角色。

en.name: Door Kickers: Action Squad
en.short_description: Rescue hostages, disarm bombs and save the day in this old school, side-scroller action game with retro graphics and retro sensibilities. Online and Couch Coop Included.

tc.name: Door Kickers: Action Squad
tc.short_description: 拯救人质、解除炸弹，并拯救这所旧学校。这是一款有着复古的画面和感觉的横版卷轴动作游戏。包含在线游戏和本地合作模式。

en.name: Tales from the Borderlands
en.short_description: Tales from the Borderlands is a five-part episodic game set on the unforgiving world of Pandora between the events of Borderlands 2 and Borderlands 3. This is a story full of Borderlands' trademark humor, following two adventurers on their quest for greatness.

tc.name: Tales from the Borderlands
tc.short_description: 《邊緣禁地傳說》是款分為五個章節的故事冒險遊戲，以嚴酷的潘朵拉世界為舞台，講的是《邊緣禁地2》和《邊緣禁地3》之間發生的事件。玩家將跟著兩位冒險者踏上宏偉征途，享受充滿《邊緣禁地》著名幽默氛圍的故事劇情。

en.name: Gears 5
en.short_description: From one of gaming’s most acclaimed sagas, Gears is bigger than ever. With all-out war descending, Kait Diaz breaks away to uncover her connection to the enemy and discovers the true danger to Sera – herself.

tc.name: Gears 5
tc.short_description: 做為遊戲史上倍受讚譽的長篇劇情史詩之一， Gears 這次將帶來比以往更廣闊的世界。全面戰爭迫在眉睫，凱特迪亞茲脫離小隊，調查她與敵人之間晦暗不明的關係，並發現錫拉星的真正危機竟是，她自身的存在。

en.name: Age of Mythology: Extended Edition
en.short_description: Age of Mythology is back! Choose your god and take to the battlefield in this classic, upgraded with full Steamworks integration and enhanced features.

tc.name: Age of Mythology: Extended Edition
tc.short_description: Age of Mythology is back! Choose your god and take to the battlefield in this classic, upgraded with full Steamworks integration and enhanced features.

en.name: LoveChoice
en.short_description: "What is love?" We try to answer that with this game. The game encourages people to have a warm, soft, and understanding heart.

tc.name: LoveChoice 揀愛
tc.short_description: "怎樣才是愛？"我們嘗試用這個遊戲去作回答。這個遊戲鼓勵人們擁有一顆溫暖柔軟，善解人意的心。

en.name: Plants vs. Zombies: Battle for Neighborville™
en.short_description: Kick some grass in Plants vs. Zombies: Battle for Neighborville, the wackiest shooter yet!

tc.name: 植物大戰殭屍™: 和睦小鎮保衛戰
tc.short_description: 在《植物大戰殭屍: 和睦小鎮保衛戰》這款爆笑射擊遊戲中大顯神威！

en.name: Subsistence
en.short_description: Subsistence is a sandbox, first person, solo or co-op, PvE open-world survival game. Struggle through changing seasons to build a base, develop technology and gear-up in the hostile environment. Defend yourself from wildlife, the elements and AI hunters (who also build bases in the world).

tc.name: Subsistence
tc.short_description: 荒野求生 是一個沙盒式 , 第一人稱視角 , 可單機或聯機 , PvE 開放式生存遊戲 . 在變換的季節中努力求生建造基地 , 發展科技和武裝自己以應付危險的環境. 保護自己免於被野生動物吃掉 , 和 環境因素 跟 NPC獵人(獵人也會建立自己的營地)

en.name: SIGNALIS
en.short_description: A classic survival horror experience set in a dystopian future where humanity has uncovered a dark secret. Unravel a cosmic mystery, escape terrifying creatures, and scavenge an off-world government facility as Elster, a technician Replika searching for her lost dreams.

en.name: Loop Hero
en.short_description: The Lich has thrown the world into a timeless loop and plunged its inhabitants into never ending chaos. Wield an expanding deck of mystical cards to place enemies, buildings, and terrain along each unique expedition loop for the brave hero.

tc.name: Loop Hero
tc.short_description: 巫妖將世界陷進了永恆的迴圈裡，讓所有居民遭受無盡的混亂。使用一副不斷擴充的神秘卡片在每一位勇敢英雄的獨特遠征迴圈裡擺上敵人、建築物與地形。在不同職業英雄的戰鬥中回收並裝備強大的戰利品，同時擴充生存者的營地以加強對每一輪迴冒險的支援。

en.name: Hand Simulator
en.short_description: There are many different levels where you can play with spinners, plunge into the subtleties of handling weapons, milk a cow, take part in a Mexican duel with your friends, have a good time fishing, play chess or simply chat in an anonymous club.

tc.name: 重裝前哨
tc.short_description: 指揮自己的移動哨站，手握“溶質槍”深入危機四伏的“天印”監控無人區，收集那些令人驚奇的武器部件，提升火力，與它並肩作戰。塔防、FPS、RTS多種玩法融為一體，靈活應對，將襲來的敵軍消滅殆盡。 在多人模式下，召集夥伴抵禦敵人、攻克前方的危機與挑戰，從“天印”手中奪回大地！

en.name: Assetto Corsa EVO
en.short_description: Assetto Corsa EVO redefines the realism and features of one of the most popular multiplatform driving simulations ever developed. Featuring cars and tracks from different classes spanning across years of motoring history.

tc.name: 《神力科莎出賽準備：進化》Assetto Corsa EVO
tc.short_description: 《神力科莎出賽準備：進化》重新定義了這款業界高人氣多平台駕駛模擬遊戲的真實性和特色。本作擁有跨越多年汽車歷史的不同級別名車和賽道。

en.name: Awesomenauts
en.short_description: Use your power, show your might! Play this Multiplayer Online Battle Arena (MOBA) game! AWESOMENAUTS combines 2D platforming with team-based strategy and hero based action. Whether you are a new recruit or an intergalactic legend, play AWESOMENAUTS!

en.name: F1® 24
en.short_description: Join the grid and Be One of the 20. Drive like the greatest in EA SPORTS™ F1® 24, the official video game of the 2024 FIA Formula One World Championship™.

tc.name: 《F1® 24》
tc.short_description: 加入競速，成為 20 名精英之一。在 2024 FIA Formula One World Championship™ 官方電玩遊戲《EA SPORTS™ F1® 24》，如高手般風馳電掣。

en.name: APB Reloaded
en.short_description: The world’s first and premier Action MMO Third Person Shooter allows you to choose between two sides of the law. Play as Enforcer or Criminal, customize your gear for the task at hand and hit the streets and play how you want in a city filled with more action this side of a Hollywood blockbuster.

en.name: Your Only Move Is HUSTLE
en.short_description: Master your technique, execute flashy combos, and outsmart opponents across the world, frame-by-frame. Slow down the clock to fine-tune your fighting style in this innovative, turn-based combat simulator. Pulverize your friends and choreograph spectacular fight scenes. No training mode required.

en.name: Divinity: Original Sin - Enhanced Edition
en.short_description: Gather your party and get ready for the kick-ass new version of GameSpot's PC Game of the Year 2014. With hours of new content, new game modes, full voiceovers, split-screen multiplayer, and thousands of improvements, there's never been a better time to explore the epic world of Rivellon!

tc.name: 大俠立志傳：碧血丹心
tc.short_description: 《大俠立志傳：碧血丹心》是一款開放世界武俠RPG遊戲，更是一款像素版江湖生存模擬器，站在一個初出茅廬的市井小人物視角，還原在江湖底層摸爬滾打最終脫穎而出的逆襲經歷。

en.name: LEGO® Batman™: The Videogame
en.short_description: When all the villains in Arkham Asylum team up and break loose, only the dynamic duo is bold enough to take them on to save Gotham City. The fun of LEGO, the drama of Batman and the uniqueness of the combination makes for a comical and exciting adventure in LEGO Batman: The Videogame.

tc.name: LEGO® Batman™: The Videogame
tc.short_description: 當阿卡漢瘋人院的所有反派合作並逃脫時，只有「動力雙人組」夠大膽，敢對付他們以拯救高譚市。LEGO 的樂趣、蝙蝠俠的劇情，以及該組合的獨特性，讓《LEGO Batman: The Videogame》帶來讓人捧腹且精彩刺激的冒險。扮演蝙蝠俠和他的搭檔羅賓，打造、駕駛，搖擺並在高譚市捕捉逃脫的反派，包括小丑，企鵝，稻草人等。然後，從另一面跳入故事，並扮演蝙蝠俠的敵人！享受你所掌握的力量、與蝙蝠俠戰鬥，並在整個城市散佈混沌。善（或惡）永不停歇。

en.name: STEINS;GATE
en.short_description: Developed by 5pb. and Nitroplus, STEINS;GATE was awarded Famitsu magazine's coveted annual Game of Excellence award and was voted one of the most emotionally charged “tear-inducing games” ever made, in a Famitsu poll.　It is a gripping and moving Visual Novel, which has already spawned manga and anime adaptations.

tc.name: STEINS;GATE
tc.short_description: 由5pb.和nitroplus共同開發的《STEINS;GATE》曾被Famitsu雜誌授予年度優秀遊戲獎項，並在Famitsu讀者調查中被評為最煽情的“催淚遊戲”。如此扣人心弦的視覺小說遊戲，現已被改編為漫畫、動畫及動畫電影等。 如今終於登陸Steam！

en.name: Scorn
en.short_description: Scorn is an atmospheric first-person horror adventure game set in a nightmarish universe of odd forms and somber tapestry.

tc.name: Scorn

en.name: Solasta: Crown of the Magister

en.name: DEATHLOOP

en.name: Dead Rising 3 Apocalypse Edition
en.short_description: Explore the zombie-infested city of Los Perdidos, and find a way to escape before a military strike wipes the entire city, and everyone in it, off the map.

en.short_description: Risk of Rain is an action platformer with roguelike elements. With permanent death as a primary feature, players will have to play their best to get as far as possible. en.name: Half-Life: Blue Shift

tc.name: not available
tc.short_description: 你是一位來自貧民窟的青少年傑基，他想要擺脫貧困，踏上了解世界和自己的旅程。 這個世界肯定已經瘋了，雖然從來沒有正常過，但也許現在就是你的機會。 危機是採取行動和果斷步驟的時候……只是它很可怕，因為每一步都可能讓你倒退很多。 有時很難選擇正確的道路，但不要害怕，你總是可以重複，我們從錯誤中學習。 傑基必須明白，為了到達一個新的地方，你必須首先跳躍並離開地面，不知道未來會發生什麼...... 武士沒有目標，只有一條路，堅忍、耐心和狡猾將幫助你到達頂峰，但你永遠不知道那裡等待著什麼...... 向前？ “只有UP！ “Only UP！” 靈感來自童話故事“傑克和豆莖”，類似於平台遊戲。 你必須經歷與傑克相同的神話之路，才能取得比攀登頂峰更多的成就。

tc.name: Call of Duty® 2

tc.name: Dark Messiah of Might & Magic
tc.short_description: 體驗全新種類的動作角色扮演遊戲，採用 Valve 的增強版 Source™ 引擎。 遊戲設於魔法門 (Might & Magic®) 的世界，玩家進入詭秘的奇幻世界，體驗激烈戰鬥，氣氛引人入勝。 刀劍、匿蹤、法術。 挑選您自己的必殺技。 尖端技術：體驗 Valve 增強版的 Source™ 引擎。 以奇幻設定為背景，發掘全新的視點，全面性的體感、逼真的動態，還有物理繪圖和完整的第一人稱對戰戰鬥系統。 步步緊湊的激戰：挑戰 12 個大型關卡的邪惡勢力，習得逾 30 種武器和各種高殺傷力的法術。 角色進化：拓展遊戲性而不受限於單一職業。 用「黑暗彌賽亞」(Dark Messiah) 的獨特技能演進系統，隨遊戲進行而習得強力的新法術和攻擊技能。

en.name: Day of Infamy
